name: Guangzhou Wondfo Biotech Co.,Ltd
summary: Guangzhou Wondfo Biotech Co.,Ltd, an in vitro diagnostics company, engages in the research and development, production, market, sale, and service of vitro diagnostic products in China and internationally.
